original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
sys.path.append("storage/shared")
from agency_lab.utilities.plot_quickstart import heatmap_v25_adjacency

OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/figures"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

res = heatmap_v25_adjacency(
  "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/joint_metrics_v2_5_adjacency.csv",
  os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "helper_v2_5_adjacency_heatmap.png"),
  normalize_rows=True
)
print("HEATMAP_RESULT", json.dumps(res, indent=2))
